subject: Workplace Skills
title: Measuring Meeting Health
description: A quick, practical guide to Measuring Meeting Health.

hook.text: A company tracked meeting hours per employee. The average was 23 hours per week. Only 8 were rated productive.

buildup.text: What gets measured gets managed. Yet most organizations track project milestones but never measure meeting quality.

discovery.text: Three metrics matter: hours in meetings per week, percentage with agenda, and post-meeting satisfaction score.

twist.text: Measuring meeting health feels like overhead. But the ROI is massive when the data reveals which meetings to cut.

climax.text: Run a quarterly survey: How many meetings felt productive? Which would you cancel? Share results openly with leadership.

punchline.text: Measure meeting health. Data drives the change you need.

quiz.question: Which three metrics track meeting health effectively?
options: Room temperature, snack quality, and chair comfort
Hours in meetings, percentage with agendas, and satisfaction scores
Number of slides, meeting length, and attendee seniority
